referenceSources.description:
Two black BMW E46 M3 GTRs, adorned with ADVAN, Castrol, and BMWCCA logos, lean into a tight corner on a sunlit racetrack. The lead car, numbered 21, displays “AUF WIEDERSEHN” on its windshield, while its pursuer bears “GOOD BYE,” underscoring the sibling rivalry theme. Their headlights pierce the track’s shadows as they battle for position.

This photograph illustrates the fierce on-track duel between BMW of North America’s Prototype Technology Group and BMW Motorsport’s Team Schnitzer during the 2001 American Le Mans Series. Both teams campaigned the E46 M3 GTR, with PTG’s P60 V8–powered cars eventually securing a dramatic victory at Petit Le Mans. The image captures the technical precision, sponsor partnerships, and competitive spirit that defined BMW’s ALMS campaign.
